Index.title: ONEfold - Organize Your Files in One Folder
Index.description: Collect documents, links, maps and notes in one place.

hero.headline: All Files in One Folder
hero.subtext: Organize scattered files for travel, projects, and daily schedules in one place.

overview.title: What is ONEfold?
overview.description: ONEfold is an app that manages all files related to a specific topic by gathering them into a single folder.
overview.supportFiles: Supported: Docs, Images, Videos, Audio, Links, Maps, Memos, etc.

files.title: File Organization
files.desc: Organize various files as visual cards

links.title: Web Links
links.desc: Save web pages and YouTube links

maps.title: Map Locations
maps.desc: Supports Google, Naver, Kakao, T Map

travel.title: International Travel
travel.desc: Passport, visa, hotel bookings, and maps in one place.

project.title: Project Management
project.desc: Plans, sheets, decks, and links in a single folder.

daily.title: Daily Schedule
daily.desc: Today's notes, meeting maps, and files organized.

step1.title: Find
step1.desc: Open the file or link you want to save.

privacy.title: Your Data Stays on Your Phone
privacy.desc: ONEfold does not store your files on any server. All data is kept securely inside your own smartphone.
privacy.note: Please note that internet links and map features require an external connection.

items.a: Yes, all features are currently free to use.
Yes, local files and notes are accessible offline. Web links and maps require an internet connection.
Files are stored only on your local device and are never uploaded to any external servers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: ONEfold values your privacy. We do not store any personal data on our servers. All files and notes remain on your local device.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: Basic terms for using the ONEfold app and website. This service is provided for personal use only.

support.title: Support & Contact
support.content: If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us via email.
